text:
Jordan: quick thread  finalizing a compact 3-email nurture for the benchmark launch + webinar. want low-friction regs + a tiny post-event drip. timeline next Tues.
Priya: agree. microbatching helps deliverability. propose waves: 7% -> 30% -> 100% over 18h. seed list 100.
Max: segment plan: infra/platform, product/pm, and trialers. small enterprise slice gets dedicated CTA. will need exact SQL for DF.
Priya: sample infra query:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role IN ('infra','platform')
  AND last_active > now() - interval '240 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND email_opt_in = true;
```
Sana: subject ideas (short):
- metric: "Benchmark: 3.1x throughput, 36% cost down"
- product: "Faster inference = better UX. See how"
Also test preheader A/B: "Join live + get the report" vs "See numbers from production workloads".
Jordan: CTA split plan: 60% -> direct webinar reg, 40% -> blog (reg CTA on post). track which converts better.
Max: please add UTM: utm_campaign=bench_micro, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content={segment}_{cta}. event tags: nl_open, nl_click, nl_register.
Priya: suppression rules: previous_webinar.no_emails, bounced_90d, partner_contacts, email_do_not_send. exclude hard bounces and spam-complaint recusals.
Sana: copy notes: keep opening line one sentence; include 1 stat + 1 customer quote in email 2. include dynamic snippet for dedicated customers: "Priority demo slots for Dedicated customers" and tag dedicated_followup=true.
ESP-Bot: preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/newsletters/1792468012 (seeds passed).
Jordan: deliverability: ramp + monitor spam complaints > 0.05% first wave pause. also throttle slices with <1% open after 3h.
Max: QA checklist: render (Gmail, Outlook, iOS), calendar .ics for day-of, link validation, text-only fallback, accessibility alt text.
Priya: timeline: copy Mon EOD, creative Tue AM, DF pull Tue evening, QA Wed morning, ramp Wed local sends.
Sana: one small test: emoji in product subject only (1 variant). keep infra subject emoji-free.
Jordan: good. Max please paste segment counts once DF runs so we can size the send.
Max: will run now and post counts in channel.
Priya: i'll assemble the newsletter brief and attach staging preview once ESP-Bot confirms final render.
Jordan: thanks team. locking plan. :rocket:
